company.headline: Every day, small business owners lose money from lack of data
company.intro: SokoSense is a WhatsApp-powered AI that helps any shop owner understand and grow their business. No app to download, no training needed.

problem.title: The blind spot killing African SMEs
problem.summary: 50% of SMEs in Rwanda and Cameroon close within five years. Not from lack of effort, but from lack of data.
problem.detail: Many owners run their business without daily visibility of inventory, pricing and cash flow. That creates a predictable survival gap in the first five years.
problem.source: World Bank enterprise and regional SME trend data, 2024

pains.title: No inventory insight
pains.text: Owners do not know what is selling until shelves are empty.
pains.quote: I did not know my flour stock was out until a customer told me.

pains.title: Guesswork pricing
pains.text: No data on market prices leads to lost margins every day.
pains.quote: I set prices by instinct and sometimes sell below my own costs.

pains.title: Cash flow blindness
pains.text: Cash flow crises arrive without warning.
pains.quote: At month end, I cannot explain where my money disappeared.

text: SokoSense is built for the realities of African markets. From neighbourhood shops in Kigali to busy trading centres in Douala, our tools help small business owners make better decisions with the data they already have.

Starting in Rwanda and Cameroon, SokoSense is designed to grow across Africa, giving entrepreneurs simple access to inventory insights, pricing intelligence and cash-flow guidance through familiar tools like WhatsApp.

features.title: WhatsApp AI
features.text: Text or voice your daily sales in French, English or Kinyarwanda.
features.example: Logged. You sold most between 6 and 8 PM.

features.title: Cash flow alerts
features.text: Real-time insights, such as: you spent 40% more than you earned this week.
features.example: Expenses are 40% above sales. Reduce low-turnover stock.

features.title: Smart suggestions
features.text: Restock top items, find your best sales hours and cut costs.
features.example: Restock soaps before Friday. Demand spikes 24% on weekends.

features.title: Competitor pricing radar
features.example: Your price is above market average. Suggested adjustment ready.

steps.title: AI processes
steps.text: SokoSense updates inventory, compares prices and forecasts.

steps.title: Get insights
steps.text: Receive plain-language alerts and weekly reports.

faq.a: No. SokoSense works through WhatsApp on any phone that supports messaging. A smartphone improves the experience, but it is not required for basic use.

faq.q: What if I have no internet?
faq.a: You can prepare your sales notes offline and send them once connected. SokoSense is designed for low-bandwidth, intermittent connections.

faq.q: Can I use it in French?
faq.a: Yes. SokoSense supports French, English and Kinyarwanda for both text and voice.

faq.q: Are prices charged in local currency?
faq.a: Yes. We show local equivalents in RWF and CFA and can support local payment channels during rollout.
